name: tools-bowsie-v1
title: BOWSIE v1.21 - Better Overworld Sprite Insertion Engine
description:
The purpose of this tool is supersede carol's, Alcaro's and wiiqwertyuiop's old overworld sprite tool by using, by default, the system used in the 9th Vanilla Level Design Contest hack. As with PIXI, it is a command line tool, and its usage is similar. It is compatible with yoshifanatic's Overworld Revolution patch.

Read the changelog for more details.
